preconditions.description: The length of the array n must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element of the array must be between 1 and 10^9.
The length of the array must match the specified length n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not can_sort(a) else True
postconditions.description: If the array cannot be sorted, output -1.

postconditions.expression: m == len(pairs) and all(1 <= u < v <= n for u, v in pairs)
postconditions.description: The number of pairs m must match the length of the pairs list, and each pair must be valid indices.
After applying the swaps, the array must be sorted in non-decreasing order.
